title: Implement rules-pack-backed guided character creation
description:
Design and implement a guided, rules-pack-backed character creation experience for Eshyra.

Goal
Users should be able to create a playable level-1 D&D 5e SRD character from the CLI without editing JSON, knowing internal record IDs, manually deriving HP, losing prior answers during revisions, or relying on the LLM as a rules source of truth.

Product decisions
- Use one shared CLI shell with rule-pack-specific character creation recipes.
- Implement the D&D 5e SRD recipe first.
- Preserve future compatibility with Pathfinder without designing speculative Pathfinder details now.
- Support both creation modes:
  1. Concept-first — I know what I want to play
  2. Ability-first — let the dice inspire me
- Runtime generated rules packs are the source of validation truth.
- Retire the legacy SRD_CATALOG after character creation no longer depends on it.

Existing beads to reconcile/fold in
- eshyra-4jiu guided session-zero flow
- eshyra-x50w SRD_CATALOG migration

The design should be captured in docs/design/character-creation-cli.md and implementation should proceed in slices small enough for coding agents.
close_reason: Completed remaining guided character creation transcript coverage and documented ADR deferral.
